title: Revisão 4 · Passado na Prática: Simple Past vs. Past Continuous

vocab.ex: While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang.
They were waiting for the bus when it started to rain.
Where did you go on vacation last summer?
What were you doing at 9 p.m. last night?
He moved to São Paulo two years ago.
Suddenly, it started to rain heavily.
While she was driving, she saw an old friend.
I was sleeping when the alarm went off.
I didn't know you were in town.
She realised she had forgotten her keys.

expressions.example: While I was cooking dinner, the lights went out.

We were walking when it suddenly started to rain.
I started this course two years ago.

sentences: While I was cooking dinner last night, the lights suddenly went out.

I didn't hear my phone because I was taking a shower.
She met her best friend while she was studying in Dublin.

grammar.title: Contando Histórias no Passado: Ação em Andamento vs. Interrupção
rules: Com datas fechadas (yesterday, last summer, in 2022), usamos o passado direto: went, worked, did you go.
Para uma ação longa que estava acontecendo no meio do caminho, usamos WAS / WERE + -ING: was cooking, were waiting.
Quando uma ação longa é interrompida por algo rápido: "While I was cooking (longa), the lights went out (rápida)".
Em perguntas e negativas no passado fechado, o "did / didn't" deixa a ação na forma base: Where did you go?
